task_input: Curated external-style canary (SlopCodeBench-inspired, pinned in-repo): incrementally disclosed ledger requirements with inherited regression checks.

implementing.plan: Apply only the currently disclosed checkpoint under core/evals/sandboxes/canary-ledger/.

checkpoints.task_input: Create core/evals/sandboxes/canary-ledger/ledger.js exporting createLedger() which returns { add(amount), balance() }. add must accept numbers; balance starts at 0 and reflects the sum of adds.

held_out_verifiers.check: node -e "const {createLedger}=require('./core/evals/sandboxes/canary-ledger/ledger.js'); const L=createLedger(); L.add(10); L.add(5); if(L.balance()!==15) process.exit(1);"

checkpoints.task_input: Extend the ledger with withdraw(amount) that decreases balance and throws if amount exceeds balance. balance() and add() behavior from the first requirement must still hold.

held_out_verifiers.check: node -e "const {createLedger}=require('./core/evals/sandboxes/canary-ledger/ledger.js'); const L=createLedger(); L.add(20); L.withdraw(7); if(L.balance()!==13) process.exit(1); let threw=false; try{L.withdraw(100);}catch{threw=true;} if(!threw) process.exit(1);"

checkpoints.task_input: Add history() returning an array of {type: 'add'|'withdraw', amount} in order. Prior add/withdraw/balance semantics remain required.

held_out_verifiers.check: node -e "const {createLedger}=require('./core/evals/sandboxes/canary-ledger/ledger.js'); const L=createLedger(); L.add(3); L.withdraw(1); const h=L.history(); if(!Array.isArray(h)||h.length!==2||h[0].type!=='add'||h[0].amount!==3||h[1].type!=='withdraw'||h[1].amount!==1) process.exit(1);"
